transit.name: Summit Stage
transit.detail: Free county buses between the towns and resorts of Summit County

nameOrigin.text: Named for Judge Marshel Silverthorn, a prospector who claimed a section of the Lower Blue River in 1881 and served as judge of the Miners Court in Breckenridge.

founded.text: Virgil Cox and Clayton Hill laid out the town streets in 1966

timeline.text: Marshel Silverthorn claimed a section of the Lower Blue River as a prospector.
Virgil Cox moved the Old Dillon Inn's bar to Silverthorne ahead of the flooding that created the Dillon Reservoir.
Virgil Cox and Clayton Hill laid out the town streets for homes and businesses.
Silverthorne was incorporated; Warren Alloway became its first elected mayor.
